blocks.text: The National Academy of Sports made a statement in its UAAP debut, capturing the gold in the girls' table tennis team event with a 3-0 sweep of University of Santo Tomas in the Season 89 final on Wednesday at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
